dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent 3-5 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit highly irregular, jagged perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from the low-intensity surrounding pixels to the high-intensity pixels forming the perimeter of these shapes, which enclose lower-intensity centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A low-density cluster of localized, solid high-intensity pixel groups is visible along the posterior ventral-lateral margin; these lack internal gradients or darker centers unlike the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Several adjacent macro-annuli on the central lateral flank are positioned with high proximity, resulting in a semi-confluent or interlocking chain-like pattern of high-contrast borders.
